summary: Comprehensive testing of FactureBTP PostgreSQL migration features completed. All features working correctly: Projects CRUD (bug fix verified), Service Categories API (6 pre-filled categories), Service Requests with category workflow, Financial Dashboard with stats and exports.

minor.issue: Fixed - was using BytesIO instead of StringIO for CSV writer

critical_code_review_comments: Projects CRUD working correctly - POST /api/projects bug is fixed
Service Categories API returns 6 pre-filled categories (Site Web, SEO, Marketing Digital, Automatisation/IA, CRM, Design) with 3 services each
Service Requests workflow: Category selection → Service selection → Form submission working
Status badges correctly colored: pending=orange, in_progress=blue, completed=green, cancelled=red
Financial Dashboard shows: Total facturé, Total encaissé, En attente, En retard with monthly chart
CSV and Excel exports working correctly
Filters by status and category working on Service Requests page
seed_data_creation: Service categories and services are auto-seeded on first API call
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL migration features tested. Key endpoints: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/projects (Chantiers), GET /api/service-categories (6 categories with services), POST/GET /api/service-requests, PUT /api/service-requests/{id}/status, GET /api/reports/financial, GET /api/reports/financial/export/csv, GET /api/reports/financial/export/excel. All working correctly.

projects_crud.details: POST /api/projects bug fixed - can create projects with minimal and full data. Update and delete working.

service_categories_api.details: GET /api/service-categories returns 6 pre-filled categories: Site Web, SEO, Marketing Digital, Automatisation/IA, CRM, Design. Each has 3 services.

service_requests_workflow.details: Category → Service → Form workflow working. Status updates (pending→in_progress→completed) working. Filters by status and category working.

status_colors.details: Colored badges: pending=orange (bg-orange-500), in_progress=blue (bg-blue-500), completed=green (bg-green-500), cancelled=red (bg-red-500)

financial_dashboard.details: Stats cards (Total facturé, Total encaissé, En attente, En retard), monthly revenue chart, invoices by status breakdown, recent payments section

exports.details: CSV export fixed (was using BytesIO, now using StringIO). Excel export working with openpyxl.

bug_fix_applied.root_cause: csv.writer was writing to BytesIO (binary stream) but CSV writer needs text stream
bug_fix_applied.fix: Changed from BytesIO to StringIO for CSV writing
